semantics.capture: On every rising and falling edge of clk, capture the value of d at that edge; q equals that sample after sequential updates settle.
semantics.hold: Between clock edges q holds the latest sampled value regardless of changes to d.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior is specified.
semantics.initialization: Initial q is unspecified until the first clock edge captures d; no initialization is added.
semantics.implementation_constraint: Use separate single-edge sequential blocks; do not use a combined posedge/negedge sensitivity list.
semantics.timing: No additional full-cycle latency. Inputs in development tests are stable across sampling edges. Physical propagation delay and clock-edge glitches are unspecified.

numeric.data: One-bit logic copied exactly, without arithmetic.

verification.oracle: Independent expected register updated to d on each driven clock transition, compared against q after NBA settling.
verification.directed: Both data values at both edge polarities; alternating and repeated samples; data changes between edges must not affect q; first capture is checked.
verification.extended: Deterministic pseudorandom samples and uneven half-cycle lengths with between-edge data mutations.
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12, -g2012, explicit dev_tb top; finite compile and simulation timeouts.
verification.scope: Development simulation and static inspection only; no official evaluation, synthesis, or board claims.

specification_ambiguities: Power-up value is unspecified and is not constrained.
Simultaneous data/clock changes, unknown clock levels, and physical edge glitches are unspecified; tests use binary clocks with data stable at each edge.
